intro.title: Projects
intro.body: Explore our portfolio of creative work, where strategy, design, and development come together to support businesses across diverse industries and markets.

items.title: Simple is More
items.description: A brand and web experience built around clarity. We stripped away noise so every page feels calm, confident, and easy to act on — from first visit to final conversion.

items.title: Mobile App Suite
items.description: A connected family of mobile screens designed for speed and delight. Users can browse, compare, and complete tasks in fewer taps without losing the brand personality.

items.title: Desktop Dashboard
items.alt: Desktop monitor with clean website UI
items.description: An operations dashboard that turns dense data into a clean working surface. Teams can scan status, spot issues, and move to action without hunting through cluttered panels.

items.title: Travel App
items.description: A booking experience that makes complex travel decisions feel simple. Clear search, honest pricing, and guided itineraries help people move from inspiration to a confirmed trip.

items.title: Lifestyle Commerce
items.description: A lifestyle storefront that feels editorial and shoppable at once. Product stories, imagery, and checkout are connected so browsing never feels disconnected from buying.

items.title: Fashion Mobile
items.description: A discovery-first fashion app for mobile shoppers. Curated collections, lookbooks, and one-tap checkout help people find what they love faster and buy with less friction.

items.title: Retail Screens
items.description: Retail product screens designed for in-hand shopping. Hierarchy, imagery, and CTAs stay consistent so customers always know what they are looking at and what to do next.

items.title: Ventures 3D
items.description: A 3D brand world for a ventures studio. The visual language feels premium and future-facing while staying flexible enough for decks, web, and campaign use.

items.title: Brand Mark V
items.description: A bold mark built to hold attention in a second. The identity is simple enough to scale from app icon to outdoor, with a color system that stays loud and controlled.

items.title: Health App
items.description: A health dashboard that makes daily progress easy to read. Charts, habits, and alerts are arranged so people can understand their status quickly and feel in control.

items.title: Analytics Dashboard
items.description: An analytics surface for teams who need signal, not noise. Charts, filters, and comparisons sit in a layout that supports fast scanning and confident decisions.

items.title: Tablet Experience
items.description: A tablet-first reading and browsing experience. Large canvases, generous type, and simple gestures make long-form content feel cinematic without losing usability.
